The *Sappaṭighaduka* ("Dyad on Impingement") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. The text analyzes conditional relations (*paccaya*) applied to phenomena with sensory impingement or reactivity (*sappaṭigha*) and those without (*appaṭigha*). None of the secondary reference passages in the dossier directly address this specific *Paṭṭhāna* section, mentioning instead the corresponding dyadic exposition of *sappaṭigha-dhamma* in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.

SuttaCentral lists no curated parallels for this text in other languages [SuttaCentral].
